examined_formations.title: CHINA_17_FTE_WIND_TOWER_EQUIPMENT_MANUFACTURER_WITH_FULL_CURRENT_ECONOMICS_PASS_BUT_LONGSTANDING_FAMILY_CONTROL_AND_ORDER_MANUFACTURING
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: The 2026 H1 same-entity report directly discloses 17 employees at period end.
Current revenue is RMB48,034,052.28, net profit RMB1,706,441.35 and consolidated operating cashflow RMB20,230,573.56.
Current business remains direct tender-led wind-tower equipment production with make-to-order procurement and production.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The company is a wind-tower equipment R&D, production and sales operator rather than a thin software or data-rights rail.
Its operating model requires steel plate, flanges, anticorrosion coating, internal accessories, production process design and batch physical delivery.
Yao Xuegen and spouse Yu Meidi directly own 100% of the company and retain actual operating control.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Orders are obtained through public tendering and the company buys materials after signing downstream sales contracts.
Production is arranged against sales orders and customer requirements, with physical material procurement and staged delivery.
Current positive OCF therefore coexists with a tender, production and working-capital operating engine rather than a machine-only control surface.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This formation passes all four Scan 122 current-economic admission legs and therefore legitimately enters primary deepening.
The control check then fails: the same husband-wife controllers own 100%, the controlling shareholder is chairman/general manager, and current reporting says controllers did not change.
The delivery check also fails because value realization requires tender acquisition, physical procurement, manufacturing and delivery.
economic_signal: 2026 H1: 17 FTE; revenue RMB48,034,052.28; net profit RMB1,706,441.35; consolidated OCF RMB20,230,573.56.
Current net margin is approximately 3.55% and gross margin 16.12%.
The full current economic conjunction passes without substituting parent-only or non-operating cashflow.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: No software-incumbent story is substituted for the actual control surface: company equity/control, customer tenders, operating relationships, production assets and working capital.
The actual controllers directly own 100% and exercise operating control, so a fresh entrant does not currently possess the decisive control position.
Physical production inputs and customer order flow are preserved as direct constraints rather than normalized away.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_15_FTE_CNC_VENTILATION_EQUIPMENT_MAKER_WITH_FULL_CURRENT_ECONOMICS_PASS_BUT_FOUNDER_FAMILY_CONTROL_AND_CUSTOMER_SPECIFIC_PRODUCTION
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: The 2026 H1 same-entity report directly discloses period-end headcount falling from 21 to 15 employees.
Current revenue is RMB8,719,805.71, attributable net profit RMB1,423,975.92 and consolidated operating cashflow RMB1,587,115.80.
The operating model remains CNC ventilation-equipment R&D, production and sales with direct customer technical interaction.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The company produces ventilation-duct processing equipment, plasma cutters, sheet-metal forming equipment, flange machines and CNC round-pipe equipment.
Current direct sales requires sales and technical personnel to understand each customer's use environment and technical requirements before R&D and production.
Founders/spouses Wang Fenquan and Zhang Guifang retain direct controlling ownership and their son is also a significant shareholder/director.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Direct sales uses face-to-face customer interaction, technical negotiation and customer-specific product-use requirements.
Inventory and payables increased as production orders and material purchasing increased during the period.
Positive OCF is explained by greater sales collections and lower purchase cash outflow, but physical production remains the delivery engine.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This formation passes all four current-economic admission legs with a materially stronger net margin than F1.

Fresh-operator reproducibility fails because current reporting says the actual controller did not change and historical disclosure traces the same husband-wife control back to the 2006 company formation.
Founder-light machine delivery also fails because product requirements, technical negotiation, R&D, production, inventory and material procurement are direct operating inputs.
economic_signal: 2026 H1: 15 FTE; revenue RMB8,719,805.71; attributable net profit RMB1,423,975.92; consolidated OCF RMB1,587,115.80.
Current net margin is approximately 16.33% and gross margin 30.43%.
The full current economic conjunction passes on the same reporting entity and period.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The decisive control surface is the family-controlled operating company, customer relationships, technical know-how, production/inventory system and supplier/material flow.
Wang Fenquan and Zhang Guifang are spouses, directly control about 88.89%, and current reporting states actual control did not change.
A fresh operator does not obtain equivalent control merely by copying product documentation or using a generic agent.

excluded_observations: Jinkun Zhiliang was excluded before primary admission: 19 FTE, RMB10,149,126.86 accounting revenue, RMB299,549.48 attributable net profit and RMB1,942.80 positive OCF appear to pass numerically, but the report states all H1 revenue RMB10,149,126.86 is lithium-battery processing income from shareholder Anhui Jinkun Technology, so the positive external-revenue gate fails.
Huayi Shares was excluded before primary admission: 16 FTE, revenue RMB20,733,162.93 and net profit RMB2,406,773.25 are positive, but consolidated OCF is negative RMB983,819.89.
Wali Technology was excluded before primary admission: 19 FTE and RMB3,253,282.80 current internet-marketing revenue coexist with net loss RMB2,255,567.22 and negative OCF RMB1,455,643.22.
Lunan Data was excluded before primary admission: 4 FTE and RMB4,648,005.33 current revenue coexist with net loss RMB1,234,975.24 and negative OCF RMB3,917,964.07.
Scan 060-121 primary formations and their primary discovery signals were excluded from Scan 122 selection; no Scan 121 formation was recycled.
No control-history deepening was spent on partial current-economic matches; the strict admission gate was applied before primary formation creation.
No job, gig, RFQ, procurement or asset-marketplace feed was used as the discovery ontology.
